_comment: Public e-commerce benchmarks used in cycle step 1 (Analyse). Rates use sessions as denominator; our 'engaged sessions' proxy is >=2 page views or an add-to-cart.

sources.name: Dynamic Yield e-commerce benchmarks
sources.note: Industry ranges, past 12 months (page partly unavailable 29 Oct 2026)

sources.name: Videowise: Ecommerce conversion funnel benchmarks (Aug 2026)
sources.note: Cites Dynamic Yield, IRP Commerce, Littledata

cvr.label: Conversion rate
cvr.note: DY global 2.66%; top 20% >3.2%; top 10% 4.7%+; Fashion & Apparel 1.4–2.9%

atc_rate.label: Add-to-cart rate
atc_rate.note: Global ~6%; top Shopify stores 7.5–9.6%; DY industry range 3.2–11.1%

selection.label: Selection index
selection.def: sessions viewing a product / engaged sessions
selection.note: No public benchmark; typical healthy range used by CRO teams

mob_desk_ratio.label: Mobile ÷ desktop conversion
mob_desk_ratio.note: Videowise: desktop ~3.0% vs mobile ~2.8%; older Adobe data: desktop ~3× smartphone
